note:
v0.29.4 更新提示修复 + 界面插画优化

· 修复应用内更新提示误报：此前 App 会提示「有新版——刷新页面更新」，但在 App 里刷新页面并不会带来任何变化，提示反复出现、无法真正更新。现在 App 只在真正有新安装包时才提示，并直接给出「下载并安装」按钮，点一下即可完成更新。
· 插画优化：引导页与介绍页的熊猫插画（诺诺）边缘更干净，与深色背景融合更自然。
· 本次网页版与 App 版本号重新对齐（均为 0.29.4），之后两边将保持同步发版。学习进度、连胜、复习计划与今日路径全部保留，无需重新设置。
noteEn:
v0.29.4 Update-prompt fix + illustration polish

· Fixed a false update prompt inside the app: the app used to say "New version available — reload the page to update", but reloading inside the app never changed anything, so the prompt kept coming back and no real update was possible. The app now only prompts when a genuine new installer exists, with a direct "Download & install" button — one tap and you are updated.
· Illustration polish: the panda mascot (Nono) on the onboarding and intro screens now has cleaner edges that blend naturally with the dark background.
· The web and app version numbers are aligned again (both 0.29.4) and will now be released in sync. Your progress, streak, review schedule and today's path are all preserved; nothing needs setting up again.
